posts.title: LMU Munich: no tuition on most programs, semester contribution applies
posts.hook: No tuition on most programs at LMU
posts.fact: LMU has charged no tuition since winter 2013/14; you pay a semester contribution. Some special master's programs do charge fees.
posts.caveat: Munich's student services organization sets the contribution amount. Living costs are separate.

posts.title: FU Berlin: 2026/27 winter semester contribution is €376.80
posts.hook: One semester's contribution at FU Berlin: €376.80
posts.fact: FU Berlin has no tuition. The 2026/27 winter semester contribution is €376.80, of which €226.80 is the semester public transport ticket.
posts.caveat: The summer 2026 amount was €358.80; the figure is updated every semester.

posts.title: Heidelberg: non-EU students pay €1,500 per semester
posts.hook: Heidelberg: €1,500 per semester for Turkish students
posts.fact: In Baden-Württemberg, non-EU/EEA students pay €1,500 tuition per semester for a bachelor's and a master's in the same field. That is €3,000 a year.
posts.caveat: The semester contribution is paid separately. EU/EEA citizens do not pay this fee.

posts.title: TUM: non-EU fees rise in winter semester 2027/28
posts.hook: TUM fees rise in winter 2027/28
posts.fact: TUM charges non-EU master's students €4,000 or €6,000 per semester. From winter 2027/28, new enrolments pay €4,600 or €6,800.
posts.caveat: Bachelor's: €2,000/€3,000, new enrolments €2,300/€3,400. Depends on the program; contribution is separate.

posts.title: RWTH Aachen: master's applications run 1 December to 1 March
posts.hook: RWTH master's applications open on 1 December
posts.fact: For non-EU applicants, winter semester master's applications run 1 December to 1 March, and summer semester ones 1 June to 1 September.
posts.caveat: Limited-place deadlines: 15 July for winter, 15 January for summer. The page gives no year, so confirm.

posts.title: TU Dresden: non-EU applicants' deadline is 31 May
posts.hook: Dresden: an earlier deadline for non-EU applicants
posts.fact: For the winter semester, non-EU applicants with foreign diplomas apply from 1 April to 31 May. With an EU or German diploma, the deadline is 15 July.
posts.caveat: Through uni-assist, first application €75. Some master's programs have different dates. No year is stated.

posts.title: HPI Potsdam: computer science master's applications, 1 April to 1 June
posts.hook: HPI's computer science master's has a short window
posts.fact: HPI takes winter semester applications from 1 April to 1 June. International applicants also need the GRE General Test.
posts.caveat: APS (diploma verification certificate) is only for diplomas from India, China and Vietnam.

posts.title: Mannheim: master's IELTS requirement ranges from 5.5 to 7.0 by program
posts.hook: Mannheim has no single IELTS score
posts.fact: IELTS ranges from 5.5 to 7.0 by master's program: Data Science and Economics 6.0, Social Data Science 6.5, Management and Finance 7.0.
posts.caveat: TOEFL iBT equivalents range from 72 to 100. Check your own program's page.

posts.title: Münster: no tuition, 2026/27 contribution is €369.50
posts.hook: Münster: €369.50 semester contribution, no tuition
posts.fact: The University of Münster charges no tuition. The semester contribution for winter 2026/27 is €369.50, about €739 a year.
posts.caveat: Covers public transport too and is updated every semester. Rent and living costs are separate.

posts.title: FAU Erlangen: fees for non-EU students from summer 2027
posts.hook: Erlangen: a new rule from summer 2027
posts.fact: From the 2027 summer semester, FAU will charge non-EU students tuition on some programs. Those starting in winter 2027/28 are also covered.
posts.caveat: New enrolments per semester: bachelor's €1,000-3,000, master's €2,000-6,000. The list is on the FAU page.

posts.title: Constructor University Bremen: 2027/28 semester fee is €11,925
posts.hook: Private university in Bremen: €11,925 per semester
posts.fact: Constructor University's 2027/28 bachelor's semester fee is €11,925, the same for EU and non-EU. The one-off enrollment fee is €940 for non-EU students.
posts.caveat: That comes to about €23,850 a year; accommodation and meals are separate. Master's fees may differ.

posts.title: Göttingen: non-EU deadline for bachelor's with limited places is 30 April
posts.hook: Göttingen: limited-place bachelor's deadline is 30 April
posts.fact: For non-EU applicants, winter semester bachelor's applications open on 1 March: programs with limited places close on 30 April, open admission on 30 September.
posts.caveat: Master's and PhD dates vary by program. The page gives no year; confirm for 2027.

posts.title: Bocconi: 2027/28 Master of Science first year is €19,300
posts.hook: Bocconi's 2027/28 master's fee is now clear
posts.fact: The first-year fee on Master of Science programs is €19,300. Partial waivers can bring it down to €15,440 or €7,720. There is no EU/non-EU distinction.
posts.caveat: The bachelor's fee is different. Waivers are granted through merit and need assessment.

posts.title: LUISS Rome: 2027/28 master's fee is €16,000, regardless of income
posts.hook: At LUISS, the fee does not vary by income
posts.fact: 2027/28 first year: master's programs €16,000, Management and Finance programs €18,000. Single contribution system; it does not vary by income bracket.
posts.caveat: Private university; no income certificate (ISEE) discount. Regional tax is paid separately.

posts.title: Cattolica Milano: non-EU master's €9,350, €6,400 with a scholarship
posts.hook: Cattolica scholarship: €6,400 instead of €9,350
posts.fact: 2026/27 first year: non-EU students with income from abroad pay €9,350 for a master's, €8,800 for a bachelor's. A UCSC scholarship cuts the master's to €6,400.
posts.caveat: With EU income, at most €6,850. You apply for the scholarship; it is not automatic.

posts.title: Domus Academy Milan: 2027/28 MA fee for non-EU students is €22,500
posts.hook: Domus Academy's non-EU rate is €5,000 a year higher
posts.fact: For 2027/28, the two-year MA costs non-EU students €22,500 a year and EU students €17,500. The 11-month Academic Master is €29,500 in total.
posts.caveat: If you apply on a Turkish passport, the non-EU rate usually applies.

posts.title: Sapienza Rome: non-EU students pay €300, €700 or €1,500 a year
posts.hook: State university in Rome: €300 to €1,500 a year
posts.fact: Sapienza charges non-EU students living abroad €300, €700 or €1,500 a year, depending on country of residence (2026/27).
posts.caveat: On the fee table, Türkiye is in group B: €700 a year (with income from abroad). Confirm 2027/28.

posts.title: Verona: flat €1,000 for non-EU students without an income certificate (ISEE)
posts.hook: Verona: a flat €1,000 option if you have no income certificate
posts.fact: Non-EU students who cannot submit ISEE, Italy's income certificate, can apply for a flat all-inclusive fee of €1,000 a year (2026/27).
posts.caveat: International master's applications for 2026/27 closed on 31 March; 2027/28 dates are not out yet.

posts.title: Bolzano: non-EU applicants can only apply in the Early Bird round
posts.hook: Bolzano's one chance for non-EU applicants: Early Bird
posts.fact: Non-EU applicants living abroad can only apply in the Early Bird round (usually March to April). The annual fee is about €1,200.
posts.caveat: Application fee €50. CIMEA (equivalence center) documents required at enrollment. The page gives no year.

posts.title: Bologna: lowest fee €157.04, with an income indicator of €27,000 or less
posts.hook: Bologna's lowest annual fee is €157.04
posts.fact: The fixed installment at Bologna is €157.04. If your family's income indicator (ISEE) is €27,000 or less, in 2026/27 you pay only this amount in your first year.
posts.caveat: Later years have a credit requirement. No document means the full fee. The cap varies by program.

posts.title: Milano-Bicocca: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 72 for English-taught programs
posts.hook: Milano-Bicocca's English requirement: IELTS 5.5
posts.fact: Non-EU applicants applying to English-taught programs on a visa need B2: IELTS Academic 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 72.
posts.caveat: From 2027/28 there are entry requirements by country; check the list for Türkiye.

posts.title: University of Turin: postgraduate applications opened in November last year
posts.hook: Turin's master's applications opened in November last year
posts.fact: The University of Turin took 2026/27 postgraduate applications from 25 November 2025 to 29 January 2026; bachelor's from 19 February to 15 April.
posts.caveat: The 2027/28 calendar is not out yet; expect a similar window, but confirm on the official page.

posts.title: Genoa: no Italian exam needed for English-taught programs
posts.hook: Genoa: no Italian exam for English-taught programs
posts.fact: English-taught programs at Genoa need no Italian test. For 2026/27, applicants who need a visa applied from 26 November 2025 to 20 March 2026.
posts.caveat: 2027/28 dates are not out yet. Last year some programs closed early. Application fee €30.

posts.title: Pavia MSc Finance: first 2027/28 application round is 12 November 2026
posts.hook: Pavia MSc Finance: first round 12 November 2026
posts.fact: Pavia MSc Finance 2027/28 application rounds: 12-18 November 2026, 12-20 January 2027 and 12-22 March 2027. The March round is for non-EU only if places remain.
posts.caveat: An example from one program; others differ. GMAT/GRE is optional but carries high weight.

posts.title: TU Delft: 2027/28 non-EU master's fee is €26,479
posts.hook: Your passport's price at TU Delft: €2,771 or €26,479?
posts.fact: In 2027/28 the statutory fee is €2,771, but non-EU/EEA students pay the institutional fee: bachelor's €20,563, master's €26,479.
posts.caveat: If you apply on a Turkish passport, the institutional (non-EU) rate usually applies.

posts.title: Erasmus Rotterdam: 2027/28 non-EU fees vary by faculty
posts.hook: In Rotterdam, your faculty can make a €5,200 difference
posts.fact: Erasmus University 2027/28 non-EU fees: bachelor's €14,700 (RSM €15,200), master's €22,800 (RSM €28,000). Medicine bachelor's €35,000.
posts.caveat: For EU/EEA citizens, the statutory fee is €2,771.

posts.title: Leiden: 2027/28 non-EU bachelor's fees range from €14,700 to €31,400
posts.hook: Leiden's bachelor's fee doubles depending on the program
posts.fact: 2027/28 non-EU bachelor's fee ranges from €14,700 to €31,400: science and biomedical €19,200, Leiden University College €21,120, medicine €31,400.
posts.caveat: Master's fees and IELTS requirements are set by program.

posts.title: Tilburg: non-EU deadline for September 2027 master's is 1 April
posts.hook: Tilburg: last day for September 2027 is 1 April
posts.fact: Non-EU master's deadline: 1 April for September 2027 entry, 1 October for February entry. IELTS 6.5 (writing and speaking 6.0) required.
posts.caveat: Exceptions: two research master's 1 March, Clinical Neuropsychology 15 January. New TOEFL: 5.

posts.title: Twente: TOEFL 100 or 5 for master's from September 2027
posts.hook: Twente's TOEFL threshold rises from September 2027
posts.fact: Master's: IELTS 6.5 (each section 6.0). TOEFL: 90 or 4.5 on the new scale for February 2027 entry; 100 or 5 from September 2027.
posts.caveat: The non-EU master's fee for 2027/28 ranges from €18,720 to €22,320 by program.

posts.title: Groningen 2027/28: master's English requirement varies by program
posts.hook: Groningen's master's IELTS requirement varies by program
posts.fact: 2027/28: most master's IELTS 6.5 (TOEFL 90 or 4.5); some law and linguistics and many research master's 7.0 (100 or 5). Literary Studies C2.
posts.caveat: There are sub-score requirements. The non-EU master's fee starts at €19,900, medicine €32,000 (2026/27).

posts.title: Wageningen: IELTS 6.5 and at least 6.0 in speaking for master's
posts.hook: At Wageningen, your speaking score counts too
posts.fact: WUR master's: IELTS overall 6.5, speaking at least 6.0; TOEFL iBT 90, speaking 22 (new scale 4.5 and 4.0). You must get the scores in a single test.
posts.caveat: The non-EU master's fee for 2027/28 is €22,560. Bachelor's requirements may differ.

posts.title: Rietveld Academie: only IELTS accepted, portfolio due 15 December
posts.hook: Rietveld Academie does not accept TOEFL
posts.fact: For 2027/28, Rietveld accepts only IELTS Academic 6.0 (speaking 6.0); TOEFL is not valid. The foundation year portfolio is due 15 December 2026.
posts.caveat: Submit the IELTS certificate with your portfolio. Year 2 and 3 applications: 1 April 2027.

posts.title: Hanze: September entry deadline for non-EU applicants is 1 June
posts.hook: Hanze: deadline for Turkish students is 1 June
posts.fact: At Hanze, the non-EU deadline is 1 June for September entry and 1 November for February entry. 1 May is only for seven countries; Türkiye is not on the list.
posts.caveat: Selective programs have other dates; immigration steps come earlier. No year given; confirm for 2027.

posts.title: The Hague UAS: non-EU €10,528, English-taught master's €14,000
posts.hook: The Hague: English-taught master's €14,000
posts.fact: At The Hague UAS, the general non-EU fee is €10,528 and a full-time English-taught master's is €14,000 (2026/27). Non-EU applications close on 1 May.
posts.caveat: Your file must be complete by 15 June. 2027 dates have not been updated yet.

posts.title: Cambridge 2027: international bachelor's fees range from £30,798 to £70,554
posts.hook: Cambridge fees run £30,798 to £70,554 by subject group
posts.fact: 2027 entry, international bachelor's: law and history £30,798, maths £34,356, architecture £40,296, engineering £46,872, medicine £70,554.
posts.caveat: College fee is separate. IELTS usually 7.5 (sections 7.0+). The 2027 UCAS date was 15 October 2026.

posts.title: LSE 2026/27: taught master's fees from £30,400 to £51,000
posts.hook: MSc Finance at LSE: £51,000
posts.fact: 2026/27 taught master's: lowest £30,400, MSc Finance £51,000, Economics £41,000, Data Science £39,900, Int. Relations £32,500.
posts.caveat: On a Turkish passport, this international fee applies. The table covers 2026/27 only.

posts.title: York 2027/28: taught master's mostly £27,840 to £34,500
posts.hook: York master's fees: £27,840 to £34,500 by subject
posts.fact: 2027/28 international taught master's: many MAs £27,840, economics £28,200, computing £33,900, finance £34,500. The law LLM at £14,390 is an exception.
posts.caveat: York has one fee table for EU and international students.

posts.title: Imperial: Standard and Higher English levels 2026/27
posts.hook: Imperial has two English levels
posts.fact: 2026/27: Standard level is IELTS 6.5 (6.0 in each section) or TOEFL 92 / new scale 4.5. Higher level is IELTS 7.0 (6.5) or TOEFL 100 / 5.0.
posts.caveat: Which level applies depends on the program. Check your program's page.

posts.title: Royal College of Art: three rounds for 2027 entry, first on 8 January 2027
posts.hook: Royal College of Art: first round closes 8 January 2027
posts.fact: Three application rounds for 2027 entry: round 1, 8 January 2027 (opened 12 October 2026); round 2, 23 March 2027; round 3, the last, 2 June 2027.
posts.caveat: Offers go out round by round, scholarships mostly in early rounds. Cut-off is 12:00 (UK time).

posts.title: Manchester MSc Economics: £35,300, IELTS 7.0 and writing 7.0
posts.hook: Manchester MSc Economics: writing score 7.0
posts.fact: MSc Economics 2027: fee £35,300, IELTS 7.0 (writing 7.0, others 6.5+) or TOEFL 100 / new scale 5. The first application stage is 6 December 2026.
posts.caveat: Later stages are 1 March, 4 May and 4 July 2027. Requirements differ for other programs.

posts.title: SOAS: TOEFL 95, IELTS 6.5 for direct entry
posts.hook: You need TOEFL 95 for direct entry at SOAS
posts.fact: SOAS direct entry requirement: IELTS 6.5 (6.0 in all sub-scores) or TOEFL iBT 95 (writing 23, others 20). On the new scale, 5.0.
posts.caveat: TOEFL is not on the approved test (SELT) list for the visa. IELTS for UKVI is recommended for the visa.

posts.title: Oxford 2027 entry: the UCAS deadline was 15 October 2026, 18:00
posts.hook: Oxford 2027 entry: UCAS closed on 15 October 2026
posts.fact: The UCAS deadline for Oxford 2027 entry was 15 October 2026 at 18:00. Fees for 2026 entry are £37,380-£62,820 by subject.
posts.caveat: Confirm the 2027 fee. Clinical years cost more. Most EU students pay the same too.

posts.title: Southampton MSc Computer Science: £36,800, same for EU and international
posts.hook: Southampton MSc Computer Science: £36,800
posts.fact: The September 2027 entry page lists MSc Computer Science at £36,800 a year. EU and international students pay the same. IELTS 6.5, 6.0 in each section.
posts.caveat: International applications close on 18 August 2027 at 12:00. They may fill up early.

posts.title: Harvard: English test not required, SAT or ACT required
posts.hook: Harvard does not require TOEFL
posts.fact: For first-year applications to Harvard College, an English test is optional, not required. The SAT or ACT is required, with limited exceptions.
posts.caveat: Not required doesn't mean the score doesn't matter. The decision is entirely Harvard's.

posts.title: Columbia: minimum IELTS 7.5 or TOEFL 105
posts.hook: Columbia's minimum: IELTS 7.5, TOEFL 105
posts.fact: Columbia asks for at least IELTS 7.5 or TOEFL iBT 105 for bachelor's applications. The page gives no new TOEFL scale equivalent, so confirm before you apply.
posts.caveat: Applicants with SAT reading and writing 700+ or ACT English or Reading section 29+ are exempt.

posts.title: University of Washington: minimum IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 76
posts.hook: Minimum English requirement in Seattle: IELTS 6.0
posts.fact: University of Washington asks first-years for IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 76 (new scale 4.0). The deadline is 15 November; test by 31 December at the latest.
posts.caveat: Meeting the minimum does not mean admission. The page does not state a year.

posts.title: UC Berkeley: TOEFL 90 or 4.5, IELTS 6.5; UC application by 30 November
posts.hook: Berkeley: TOEFL 90, UC application by 30 November
posts.fact: For English, Berkeley asks for TOEFL 90, or 4.5 on the new scale, or IELTS 6.5. UC applications for fall 2027 run from 1 October to 30 November 2026.
posts.caveat: The UC system has no early round: one application, multiple campuses. Scores by 31 January.

posts.title: UC Irvine: fall 2026 entry out-of-state tuition and fees $59,375
posts.hook: Irvine's yearly bill for out-of-state students: $59,375
posts.fact: An out-of-state bachelor's student starting in fall 2026 pays $59,375 in 2026-27. Of that, $39,270 is the out-of-state surcharge and $3,214 is health insurance.
posts.caveat: International students pay this too. Fall 2027 rates may differ. Housing is separate.

posts.title: Carnegie Mellon 2026-27: bachelor's tuition $69,702
posts.hook: Carnegie Mellon 2026-27 tuition: $69,702
posts.fact: Carnegie Mellon's flat bachelor's tuition for 2026-27 is $69,702 ($969 per unit). Fees and living costs are separate.
posts.caveat: There is no EU distinction in the USA. Estimated total cost for a first-year in a dorm is $93,614.

posts.title: Princeton: SAT/ACT optional for fall 2027, required in 2028
posts.hook: Princeton: SAT optional for fall 2027
posts.fact: At Princeton, the SAT/ACT is optional for fall 2026 and 2027 entry and required again for fall 2028. You need two teacher references and one counselor reference.
posts.caveat: If your schooling is not in English, a language test is required, no minimum. Regular deadline: 1 January.

posts.title: Semester contribution in Germany: six universities
posts.hook: What's the semester contribution in Germany? Six universities
posts.note: Amounts are per semester, updated each semester, and exclude tuition. In Baden-Württemberg, non-EU students also pay €1,500.

posts.title: Baden-Württemberg rule: non-EU students pay €1,500 per semester
posts.hook: In this state, non-EU students pay €1,500 per semester
posts.note: State rule: €3,000 a year. The semester contribution is paid separately. EU/EEA citizens pay no tuition.

posts.hook: Non-EU bachelor's fees: from Delft to Rotterdam
posts.note: 2027/28 fees. At Leiden and Rotterdam they rise by subject. On a Turkish passport, the institutional rate usually applies.

posts.title: Netherlands universities of applied sciences: non-EU fees 2026/27
posts.hook: Non-EU fees at universities of applied sciences (2026/27)
posts.note: 2026/27 institutional fees. Most give no 2027/28 amount (Windesheim about €9,580). EU/EEA statutory fee: €2,694.

posts.title: Private universities in Italy: annual fee examples
posts.hook: Annual fee examples at private universities in Italy
posts.note: Years are mixed (2026/27 and 2027/28). At Bocconi and Cattolica, exemptions and scholarships can lower the fee. Bachelor's fees differ.

posts.note: The fee depends on ISEE (a family income indicator) or a country list. The upper limit varies by program. Ask the university about extra charges.

rows.label: UCLA
rows.sub: out-of-state, total with surcharge and fees

posts.note: The out-of-state rate also applies to international students. Housing and books are not included. Insurance is included only at Irvine.

posts.title: Published minimum IELTS scores in the USA
posts.hook: Published IELTS minimums in the USA
posts.note: These are minimums for bachelor's applications. Harvard, Stanford, NYU and Northwestern do not publish a minimum. A minimum is not a guarantee of admission.

posts.title: New TOEFL scale: university thresholds on the 1-6 band
posts.hook: After 21 January 2026, your TOEFL score runs from 1 to 6
posts.note: On the new scale, the overall score is the average of the four sections. Until 2028, ETS also shows the old equivalent on score reports. Confirm with the university.

posts.title: USA fall 2027: SAT/ACT policy varies by university
posts.hook: Need the SAT for fall 2027? It depends on the university
posts.note: Policies change year by year. Check the page for the cycle you are applying in. Not required does not mean your score is useless.

posts.title: Key dates for USA fall 2027 bachelor's applications
posts.hook: Key dates for fall 2027 bachelor's applications

rows.label: Vanderbilt
rows.sub: second early decision and regular decision

posts.note: Early rounds are usually 1-2 November. Most universities use the Common App. UC uses its own system, and UT Austin accepts both.

posts.title: Deadlines for non-EU applicants in the Netherlands
posts.hook: Non-EU? In the Netherlands, the deadline is not 1 May everywhere
posts.note: Most pages do not state a year. The dates repeat each year, but confirm 2027 with the university. The general Studielink date is 1 May.

posts.title: Germany winter semester: application windows
posts.hook: When do winter semester applications open in Germany?

posts.note: These windows recur and no year is stated. Confirm them for 2027/28. Add 8 weeks for the uni-assist preliminary review document (VPD).

posts.title: Master's IELTS thresholds in the Netherlands
posts.hook: English thresholds for a master's in the Netherlands
posts.note: There are sub-score requirements and exceptions. If you studied in English, you may be exempt.

posts.title: Myth: university in Germany is completely free
posts.claim: University in Germany is completely free
posts.truth_title: Most places: no tuition, but a semester contribution
posts.truth: No tuition at most universities, but a contribution every semester: FU Berlin €376.80, Münster €369.50 (winter 2026/27). Rent and living costs are separate.

posts.title: Myth: no fees anywhere in Germany
posts.claim: There is no tuition anywhere in Germany
posts.truth_title: There are exceptions: Baden-Württemberg, TUM, FAU
posts.truth: Baden-Württemberg: €1,500 per semester for non-EU students. TUM master's: €4,000 or €6,000 (from 2027/28: €4,600 or €6,800). FAU will also charge from summer 2027.

posts.title: Myth: university in the Netherlands is €2,771 a year
posts.claim: University in the Netherlands is €2,771 a year
posts.truth_title: That fee is for EU passports
posts.truth: The €2,771 statutory fee (2027/28) is for EU/EEA passports. On a Turkish passport, you usually pay the institutional fee: Delft master's €26,479, Erasmus €22,800.

posts.title: Myth: EU citizens pay home fees in the UK
posts.claim: If you are an EU citizen, you pay home fees in the UK
posts.truth_title: An EU passport does not get you home fees
posts.truth: As an EU citizen starting in 2026/27, you pay the same fee as international students unless you have UK residence status (settled/pre-settled).

posts.title: Myth: you cannot apply in Italy without a Dichiarazione di Valore
posts.claim: You cannot apply in Italy without a Dichiarazione di Valore
posts.truth_title: CIMEA documents are also an option
posts.truth: For your diploma, the circular says CIMEA (equivalence center) documents or a Dichiarazione di Valore from the consulate. The university chooses, so ask first.

posts.title: Myth: state university fees in Italy are the same for everyone
posts.claim: State university fees in Italy are the same for everyone
posts.truth_title: Fees are based on family income
posts.truth: The fee depends on ISEE (a family income indicator). In Bologna, an ISEE of €27,000 or below pays €157.04 in the first year (2026/27). Sapienza charges a fixed fee by country.

posts.title: Myth: Turkish students also need an APS certificate for Germany
posts.claim: Turkish students also need an APS certificate for Germany
posts.truth_title: The uni-assist list names three countries
posts.truth: In the uni-assist glossary, APS (a diploma verification certificate) is required only for China, India and Vietnam. Türkiye is not mentioned. Ask the university too.

posts.title: Myth: you cannot apply in the USA without TOEFL
posts.claim: You cannot apply in the USA without TOEFL
posts.truth_title: Some schools never ask for it
posts.truth: At Harvard an English test is optional, and Stanford does not ask for one at all. Columbia wants at least TOEFL 105 or IELTS 7.5. Check school by school.

posts.title: Myth: TOEFL is still scored out of 120
posts.claim: TOEFL is still scored out of 120
posts.truth_title: The scale changed: now from 1 to 6
posts.truth: TOEFL iBT taken after 21 January 2026 is reported on a 1-6 band. Band 5 equals 95-106 on the old scale. New thresholds: Berkeley 4.5, Caltech 5.

posts.title: Myth: I can always apply to the Netherlands until 1 May
posts.claim: I can always apply to the Netherlands until 1 May
posts.truth_title: Some institutions set an earlier non-EU date
posts.truth: Numerus fixus closes on 15 January. At Tilburg, Rotterdam UAS and Aeres, the deadline for non-EU applicants is 1 April. 1 May is only the general date.

posts.title: Myth: the UCAS deadline is always late January
posts.claim: The UCAS deadline is always late January
posts.truth: For most bachelor's programs on UCAS, the equal consideration date is 13 January 2027 at 18:00. For Oxford, Cambridge and medicine, it was 15 October 2026.

posts.title: Myth: no school in the USA asks for the SAT anymore
posts.claim: No school in the USA asks for the SAT anymore
posts.truth_title: Many schools have made it required again
posts.truth: Harvard, Yale, MIT and Stanford ask for the SAT or ACT. It is optional at Duke and Vanderbilt. At Princeton it is optional in 2027 and required in 2028.

posts.title: Myth: uni-assist is free and you only apply once
posts.claim: uni-assist is free and you only apply once
posts.truth_title: You pay per program and per semester
posts.truth: First program €75, each extra program in the same semester €30. You pay again in a new semester. VPD (preliminary review) takes 4-6 weeks and is valid for one year.

posts.title: 13 January 2027: UCAS equal consideration date
posts.detail: Applications received by 18:00 (UK time) get equal consideration. After that, it is at the university's discretion.

posts.title: 26 January 2027: Bocconi bachelor's Winter Session closes
posts.detail: Bachelor's and law 2027/28: opens 25 November 2026, closes 26 January 2027 at 15:00 (Italy time). Results in mid-March.

posts.title: 28 February 2027: Design Academy Eindhoven bachelor's
posts.detail: Deadline for bachelor's applications for 2027 entry. Two dates for master's: 29 January 2027 and 29 March 2027.

posts.title: 4 January 2027: Caltech Regular Decision
posts.detail: First-year application for fall 2027. The early round closed on 1 November 2026. IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL 5 on the new scale, in each section.

posts.title: 1 January 2027: Vanderbilt ED II and Regular Decision
posts.what: Vanderbilt: second early decision and regular decision
posts.detail: For fall 2027, ED II and Regular Decision are on the same day. The first early decision (ED I) was 1 November 2026. SAT/ACT is optional.

posts.title: Germany: uni-assist and VPD step by step
posts.hook: uni-assist and VPD: the way to apply to some German universities

steps.title: Check the university
steps.body: Not every university uses uni-assist. The university tells you whether it asks for a VPD (pre-assessment document).

steps.title: Open a My assist account
steps.body: Create your online application and upload your diploma and transcript. The university tells you which documents you need.

steps.title: Pay the fee
steps.body: First program €75, each extra one in the same semester €30. Payment requests only come through the uni-assist portal.

steps.title: Wait for the VPD
steps.body: Processing usually takes 4 to 6 weeks. Apply at least 8 weeks before the deadline. A VPD is valid for one year.

steps.title: Upload to the university
steps.body: Send the VPD and your other documents to the university's own portal, before its own deadline.

posts.note: Some universities take applications directly; at others, uni-assist forwards them. The fee applies again each semester.

posts.title: Netherlands: applying through Studielink in four steps
posts.hook: Applying on Studielink in four steps

steps.title: Find the program
steps.body: Pick the program on Studyfinder and check the application route on the institution's page. Some use a different route.

steps.title: Register on Studielink
steps.body: Open an account, add your past education and submit. The institution may then ask for more documents on its own portal.

steps.title: Watch the dates
steps.body: Numerus fixus closes on 15 January at 23:59; the general date is 1 May. Institutions may set earlier dates for non-EU applicants.

steps.title: Accept the offer
steps.body: Numerus fixus rankings come out on 15 April. If you don't accept the offer within two weeks, the place goes to someone else.

posts.note: Apply to at most two numerus fixus programs a year; in fields like medicine, one application a year to that program.

posts.title: Italy: how Universitaly pre-enrollment works
posts.hook: How pre-enrollment for the visa works in Italy

steps.title: Get admitted first
steps.body: Complete the university's own application. Universitaly pre-enrollment doesn't replace admission; the university approves.

steps.title: Pre-enroll on Universitaly
steps.body: Fill in the pre-enrollment form on the ministry's portal (no fee). The university approves the application digitally.

steps.title: Meet the language requirement
steps.body: At least B2 for bachelor's and master's. For foreign-language programs, the visa needs a B2 certificate covering four skills.

steps.title: Go to the consulate
steps.body: Apply with your approved pre-enrollment summary, diploma, equivalence document (CIMEA or Dichiarazione di Valore) and proof of funds.

steps.title: Don't miss the dates
steps.body: Bachelor's and master's: apply for the visa by 31 October 2027. No enrollment by 31 January 2028 means the visa is cancelled.

posts.note: 2026/27 and 2027/28 circular. Universities may set their own earlier dates.

posts.title: UK: bachelor's applications through UCAS and 2027 dates
posts.hook: Bachelor's applications through UCAS: one form, key dates

steps.title: Open an account, add choices
steps.body: Applications for 2027 entry opened on UCAS on 12 May 2026. You apply to more than one university with a single form.

steps.title: Know the deadlines
steps.body: Oxford, Cambridge, medicine, dentistry, veterinary closed 15 October 2026. Most programs: 13 January 2027, 18:00 (UK time).

steps.title: If you are late
steps.body: Extra (an added choice) opens on 25 February. Applications received by 30 June 2027 are forwarded, then it's Clearing.

steps.title: Over the summer
steps.body: Clearing (applying for unfilled places) opens on 2 July 2027. The deadline is 23 September 2027.

posts.note: Master's applications go directly to the university, not through UCAS, and dates vary by program.

posts.title: USA: steps for applying through Common App
posts.hook: Applying on Common App: a five-part summary

steps.title: Gather your documents
steps.body: High school transcript, activities, test scores if you have them, family details. Your school counselor sends the School Report.

steps.title: Open an account, add schools
steps.body: You can open an account any time. The 2026-27 season has more than 1,200 member institutions.

steps.title: Invite your recommenders
steps.body: Each university sets its own recommendation requirements: counselor, teacher, sometimes a coach or employer.

steps.title: Essays
steps.body: Personal essay: required at some schools, optional at others. There may also be school-specific questions and a writing supplement.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Each university has its own deadline. Testing policy (required or optional) also varies by school.

posts.note: The UC system uses its own application. UT Austin accepts both Common App and ApplyTexas.

posts.title: Germany: blocked account and how to show €11,904
posts.hook: How to show €11,904 for a German visa

steps.title: Know the amount
steps.body: According to DAAD's Study in Germany portal, in most cases you need to show €11,904 for one year.

steps.title: Choose a method
steps.body: Blocked account (Sperrkonto), bank guarantee, commitment from someone living in Germany, family income or scholarship letter.

steps.title: Open the account early
steps.body: Apply for the blocked account early. Processing usually takes a week, and the confirmation goes in your visa file.

steps.title: Check with the consulate
steps.body: The German mission in your country decides which proof it accepts and the current amount.

posts.note: The amount depends on estimated living costs and is updated. Confirm before you apply.

posts.title: Italy: public university fees and proof of income
posts.hook: In Italy, your income sets your public university fee

steps.title: What is ISEE
steps.body: Family income and assets indicator. At Bologna, €27,000 or less pays only a €157.04 installment in the first year (2026/27).

steps.title: Income abroad
steps.body: If your income is in Türkiye, you need separate documents instead of ISEE. Some institutions charge a fixed fee by country.

steps.title: Examples
steps.body: At Sapienza, the Türkiye group pays €700 (bands €300, €700, €1,500). At Verona, a fixed €1,000 for non-EU students without ISEE.

steps.title: Timing
steps.body: Bologna 2026/27: first installment €157.04 for bachelor's on 24 September 2026; second 18 December, third 15 March 2027.

posts.note: The cap depends on the program. Ask the university about extra costs.

posts.title: Language certificates: IELTS, TOEFL and the new TOEFL scale
posts.hook: IELTS or TOEFL, and what the new TOEFL score means

steps.title: TOEFL has changed
steps.body: Since 21 January 2026, TOEFL iBT uses a 1-6 scale with half bands. A section average replaces the old 0-120 total.

steps.title: Equivalents
steps.body: B2 = 4 and 4.5, C1 = 5 and 5.5, C2 = 6. For example, band 5 matches 95-106 on the old scale.

steps.title: Read the report
steps.body: For two years, the ETS report shows CEFR, the 1-6 score and the old equivalent together. The single scale starts in 2028.

steps.title: What universities ask for
steps.body: Berkeley 4.5, Imperial Standard 4.5, Tilburg 5 for September 2027. Some institutions, like Rietveld, only take IELTS.

posts.note: TOEFL is not on the approved test list (SELT) for a United Kingdom visa. SOAS recommends IELTS for UKVI.

posts.title: Proof of funds for a student visa: five countries, five rules
posts.eyebrow: PROOF OF FUNDS FOR A VISA
posts.hook: Student visa proof of funds: five countries, five rules

steps.title: Germany
steps.body: €11,904 for one year (DAAD). A blocked account is one option. Ask the consulate which one applies.

steps.title: Netherlands
steps.body: Dutch immigration service (IND) 2026 amount: €1,130.77 a month, valid until 31 December 2026.

steps.title: Italy
steps.body: 2026/27 and 2027/28 circular: €10,179.85 a year. The source must be legal, traceable and preferably your own or family money.

steps.title: UK
steps.body: 1 year of tuition + £1,529 a month (London) or £1,171, for 9 months; 28 days in your account. Visa £558, healthcare £776/year.

steps.title: USA
steps.body: No fixed amount on the official page. The school registers you in SEVIS and issues Form I-20. Visa issued up to 365 days before classes.

posts.note: Amounts are updated during the year. Check the official page on the day you apply.

posts.title: Countdown to September 2027: application calendar
posts.hook: Plan backwards to start in September 2027

steps.title: November-December 2026
steps.body: UC applications close on 30 November. US regular applications: 1-5 January. For the UK, UCAS is 13 January 2027.

steps.title: January-March 2027
steps.body: Netherlands numerus fixus 15 January. Bocconi bachelor's Winter Session 26 January. RWTH master's 1 March.

steps.title: April-June 2027
steps.body: Netherlands non-EU dates fall between 1 April and 1 June. Germany winter semester: Dresden 31 May, HPI 1 June.

steps.title: June-August 2027
steps.body: Admission letters, proof of funds, visa appointment. You can get a US visa up to 365 days before classes start.

steps.title: September 2027
steps.body: Enrollment, orientation. In Italy, bachelor's and master's visa applications by 31 October 2027, enrollment by 31 January 2028.

posts.note: These dates are examples. Your program's own page takes priority. Add 8 weeks for steps like the uni-assist document (VPD).

posts.title: USA F-1 student visa: from admission to flight
posts.hook: USA student visa: from admission to flight

steps.title: SEVP-approved school
steps.body: Your school must be in the US student program (SEVP). It enters you in SEVIS and issues Form I-20, your admission document.

steps.title: I-901 SEVIS fee
steps.body: Pay it on FMJfee.com before you apply for the visa. Your details must match your I-20 exactly.

steps.title: Consulate interview
steps.body: An interview is required for ages 14-79. Take your I-20 with you. The order of steps can vary by consulate.

steps.title: Timing
steps.body: The visa can be issued up to 365 days before your course starts. You can enter the USA no earlier than 30 days before.

posts.note: If you got I-20s from more than one school, choose one for the visa. Your name and date of birth must match your passport.

posts.title: How numerus fixus works in the Netherlands
posts.hook: How numerus fixus programs work in the Netherlands

steps.title: What it is
steps.body: Programs with limited places. You apply through Studielink by 15 January, 23:59 (CET).

steps.title: Selection process
steps.body: The institution makes its selection between 15 January and 15 April. On 15 April you see your ranking number in Studielink.

steps.title: Limits
steps.body: At most two numerus fixus programs a year. Only one application in medicine, dentistry, dental hygiene and physiotherapy.

steps.title: The offer
steps.body: Accept within two weeks or the place goes to someone else. With fewer applicants than places, everyone gets an offer on 15 April.

posts.note: The general date for other programs is 1 May. Institutions may set earlier dates for non-EU applicants.

posts.title: Diploma document for Italy: CIMEA or Dichiarazione di Valore
posts.hook: Diploma document for Italy: CIMEA or Dichiarazione di Valore?

steps.title: There are two routes
steps.body: The circular recognizes two routes: CIMEA (equivalence center) documents or the Dichiarazione di Valore. The university chooses.

steps.title: What universities say
steps.body: Bari Polytechnic and Verona accept both. At Florence, you need one before enrollment (2024/25 page).

steps.title: For visa-exempt applicants
steps.body: Turkish passport holders are not in this group. The circular recommends not asking visa-exempt applicants for the Dichiarazione.

steps.title: Allow time
steps.body: Request documents early. For high school, the visa file needs the original diploma and, if required, an Italian translation.

posts.note: In Lisbon Convention countries (Türkiye included), the CIMEA comparability document can be downloaded from the ARDI site.
